description: For the always false table, canonical DNF is \(\bot\) and canonical CNF is equivalent to \(\bot\); for the always true table, canonical CNF is \(\top\) and canonical DNF is equivalent to \(\top\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.canonical_false_true.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.dnfFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.canonicalDnf p fun x => false) =
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.falsum ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.cnfFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.canonicalCnf p fun x => true) =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.verum ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SemEquivalent
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.cnfFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.canonicalCnf p fun x => false))
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.falsum ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SemEquivalent
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.dnfFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.canonicalDnf p fun x => true))
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.verum
